release.name: UAV-02 reproducibility package v2.0.0 (corrected v2 campaign)
release.body:
Reproducibility package for the UAV-02 manuscript, version 2.0.0.

**What changed since 1.0.0.** In the ISOT extractor the `Duration` column holds the IP time-to-live, not a duration; the v1 intervention multiplied it into impossible values (> 255). A post-hoc ablation on the frozen v1 checkpoints showed that this edit produced the v1 Regular-recall response, the Regular/Video→MITM redirection and nearly all of the H1 contrast. This release adds a corrected v2 campaign:

- `v2/DESIGN_V2.md`, `v2/SHA256SUMS_v2`, `v2/code/` — frozen and pushed before any v2 execution (tag `uav02-v2-confirmatory-freeze`): Duration removed, physical-range guard, fresh seeds 76/87/98/109/120, validation only.
- `v2/results_confirmatory/`, `v2/logs/` — 40 runs, checkpoints and the frozen analysis, run once (tag `uav02-v2-results`).
- `v2/post_hoc/` — Figures 2–5 and the pooled H2 table; `v2/release_tools/rerun_v2_analysis.py` re-runs the frozen analysis and checks it byte for byte.
- `post_hoc/review_2026-11-06/` — the Duration ablation.

v2 outcomes: primary macro-F1 gate passes in all six algorithm–schedule combinations (5/5 seeds each); Regular-recall response ≤ 0.0002 as predicted; H1, H2a and H2b fail. All v1 files are unchanged. See `v2/README.md`.

The ISOT Drone Dataset is third-party and not redistributed.

release.name: UAV-02 reproducibility package v1.0.0
release.body:
Reproducibility package for "Controlled Temporal Covariate Drift in Federated UAV Intrusion Detection: Separating Immediate Response, Training History, and Post-Removal Residuals" (A. Banjar, University of Jeddah).

**Contents**
- Protocol and code frozen before any confirmatory execution: tag `uav02-confirmatory-freeze-v1` (commit `0a201c8`, 2026-09-25). The design document `DESIGN_FROZEN.md` is in Arabic and is left unchanged on purpose.
- All confirmatory outputs: tag `uav02-confirmatory-results-v1` (commit `7ac37fa`). 5 seeds × FedAvg/FedProx × 4 schedules × 45 rounds, with round-level metrics, confusion matrices, 480 checkpoints, provenance and the frozen analysis.
- Post-hoc analyses, labeled as such, including a held-out-test evaluation added after the confirmatory results were seen (`post_hoc/`).
- `release/`: one-command scripts that regenerate every manuscript table (2–6) and figure (1–5) from the saved outputs, verify them cell by cell against the manuscript, check a local copy of the dataset by SHA-256, and re-run the frozen training under its frozen-state guard.

**Not included:** the third-party ISOT Drone Dataset (obtain it from the ISOT Research Lab, University of Victoria). Bitwise reproducibility of training across hardware backends is not claimed.

License: MIT. See `CITATION.cff` for citation.
